basic_info_description:
RENTAL FEATURES:
(1) 2 large bedrooms (master bed w/ walk in closet) 
(2) Full bath w/ separate tub and shower
(3) Private Entrance
(4) Washer/Dryer onsite 
(5) Large fenced backyard space
(6) 2 car enclosed tandem garage, plus 1 car driveway and plenty of street parking 
(7) Impressive hand crafted mantel and fireplace in spacious living room 
(8) Bright dining area adjacent to kitchen
(9) Newly renovated eat-in kitchen with well-appointed tile countertops, stainless steel dual gas oven, dishwasher, disposal, and ample cabinet space
(10) Original hardwood and floors throughout
(11) Interior freshly painted
(12) Central heating system
(13) Large Garage with storage room (apprx. 200 SF)

COMMUNITY FEATURES:
(1) Transit Score = 79 out of 100, Excellent Transit is Convenient to Most Trips
(2) Safe neighborhood
(3) Near parks and recreational facilities
(4) Located 4.5 blocks from the Ocean Avenue corridor providing access to public transit: BART (Balboa station) and Muni (light rail and bus), plus all your basic living necessities found at nearby Walgreens, CVS, Target, and/or Whole Foods.  
(5)  Near recreational facilities: 2 blocks from Ocean View and Minnie & Lovie Ward Recreational Center - new baseball and soccer fields.  
(6)  The location is extremely convenient for City College of San Francisco/San Francisco State University students as public transit is a 1-3 minute walk away from the house.  
(7)  Close to public transportation and easy freeway access.

LEASE TERMS:
(1) Tenants/Occupants to pay all utilities
(2) Utilities not included in rent price
(3) Available immediately 
(4) Parking Fee: $0 
(5) Pets: Small Dog ( 20 lbs) or cat allowed 
(6) Pet Rent:  $150/ month
(7) This is a non-smoking unit

Listed by:  CEF Realty Advisors, Inc.
Contact brad@cefrealty.com OR (510) 755-2335 to schedule a tour

Utilities not included in rent price
